title: Unmasking and Quantifying Racial Bias of Large Language Models in Medical Report Generation
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on quantifying racial bias in medical report generation.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its analysis was exclusively focused on racial bias.
